records = data['streaming_rankings']['data']
platforms = data['streaming_rankings']['platforms']
quarters = [r['quarter'] for r in records]

colors = {
    'Netflix': '#E50914',
    'Amazon Prime Video': '#00A8E1',
    'Spotify': '#1DB954',
    'Disney+': '#113CCF',
    'Apple TV+': '#A2AAAD',
    'HBO Max': '#B535F6',
    'YouTube Premium': '#FF0000',
    'Hulu': '#1CE783',
}

linewidths['Netflix'] = 3.2
linewidths['Disney+'] = 3.2
linewidths['Amazon Prime Video'] = 2.2
linewidths['Spotify'] = 2.2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 8))

ax.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

x = np.arange(len(quarters))

    ranks = [r.get(platform) for r in records]

    zorder = 2
    if platform == 'Netflix':

    elif platform == 'Disney+':

    ax.plot(xs, ys, color=colors[platform], linewidth=linewidths[platform],

            path_effects=[pe.Stroke(linewidth=linewidths[platform]+1.5, foreground='white'), pe.Normal()])
    
    # Labels at start and end
    offset = 0.3
    # Start label
    ax.text(xs[0] - offset, ys[0], platform, ha='right', va='center',

    # End label
    ax.text(xs[-1] + offset, ys[-1], platform, ha='left', va='center',

ax.set_yticks(range(1, 9))
ax.set_ylim(8.6, 0.4)
ax.set_xlim(-2.5, len(quarters) + 1.5)

ax.set_xticks(tick_indices)
ax.set_xticklabels([quarters[i] for i in tick_indices], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)

ax.set_ylabel('Rank Position (1 = Most Subscribers)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Streaming Platform Rankings by Subscriber Base\nQ1 2019 – Q1 2025',

ax.tick_params(colors='#555555')
